goal: Determine whether CRM customer updates unilaterally overwrite ERP billing addresses during sync collisions.
successCriteria: Investigate Master Data precedence rules between CRM and ERP agreements.

evidence.passage: CRM is designated as the sole system of record for customer records; all address mutations originate in CRM and overwrite downstream ERP records unconditionally.
Finance Directive: ERP billing address is immutable and cannot be updated via CRM webhooks without certified accountant sign-off.

proposedAnswer: During synchronization collisions, CRM customer updates always override ERP billing records.
